title: Kahn's topological sort with alphabetical tie-breaking
contract: Edges go key -> each element of its value list (key comes first). Every node named as a key or inside a value list appears exactly once. Ready nodes are emitted in ascending alphabetical order, making output deterministic. Null or empty value lists mean no outgoing edges; duplicate edges are ignored; a null graph is empty. A cycle throws IllegalArgumentException whose message names at least one node in the cycle -- the exact wording is not graded, only the type and that a cycle node is mentioned.
